messages:
Maria Chen: Starting a staged v2 rollout for the text-generation endpoint in eu-west-1 at 23:00 UTC tonight. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 90m with deploy-bot. Canaries on mobile tenant list. Ping if any tenant pins needed. deploy-bot schedule below.

DeployBot: Scheduled rollout created: /deploy start v2-text-gen --region eu-west-1 --stages 5,25,100 --window 90m --canary "mobile-*,alpha-*" --change-window 23:00-01:00UTC

Samir Patel: Question — what's the rollback trigger? latency >80th pct + error rate >2% for 5m? We should also pin mobile tenants if they see regressions.

Jen Ortiz: For rollback criteria let's use: (p50 increase >50ms) OR (errors >1.5% sustained 10m) OR client 5xx spikes in any tenant + support escalations. Also include automatic re-route to v1 for pinned tenants.

Leo Winters: Also need to add schema compatibility check in release notes. v2 changes: 'metadata' field renamed to 'meta' (optional), new 'response_tokens' array. We'll put a short diff in the notes.

OpsOnCall: Heads up — we're still investigating increased gateway timeouts in eu-west-1 (incident INC-2026-112). Can we hold the EU rollout until that's resolved? Prefer not to mix with rollout.

Maria Chen: Good catch. Pausing schedule. @DeployBot cancel 6523456789

DeployBot: Rollout cancelled by Maria Chen. runbook: /deploy status 6523456789

Jen Ortiz: I'll update release notes and include migration snippet and rollback steps. Draft link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/v2-rollout-notes-6523456789

Samir Patel: Also suggest forcing header normalization for mobile SDKs during next patch to avoid case sensitivity issues seen in last cutover.

Maria Chen: OK team — hold until Ops clears EU. If incident resolved by 20:00 UTC we'll reschedule to 23:00; otherwise we'll move to next maintenance window. Adding tenant pin checklist to deploybot.

DeployBot: Added pin checklist: --pin tenant:mobile-uk --pin tenant:alpha-1

Leo Winters: Thx. I'll add a quick test harness for client probes and TTL drift check.

OpsOnCall: Update — root cause identified, mitigation applied, gateway latency trending down. Recommending reschedule but keep canary smaller (3%) and extend observation to 20m per stage.

Maria Chen: Reschedule: /deploy start v2-text-gen --region eu-west-1 --stages 3,10,50,100 --window 120m --stage-observe 20m --canary "mobile-*,alpha-*"

Samir Patel: Approved. Ops and SRE on eyes for first 45m. If anything odd ping #eng-oncall.

Jen Ortiz: I'll publish release notes and cross-post to #release-notes and send tenant comms.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Will kick at 23:00 UTC if no new flags. :thumbsup:
